title: Scaffold field parsing
responsibility: Converts field specifications into normalized code names, database columns and supported language types.

inputs.name: parseFields.rawFields
inputs.description: Field strings in name:type form; omitted type defaults to string. Supported types are string, text, number, boolean, date and json.

outputs.name: parseFields
outputs.description: Fields in input order with camelCase name, snake_case column, normalized type and TypeScript/SQL types. String/text/date use TEXT, number/boolean use INTEGER, and json uses Record<string, unknown> stored as TEXT.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown for malformed field syntax, invalid field names, unsupported types or duplicate normalized names.
